correctness.rationale: All Boolean cardinality-balance equations are exactly 40 signed ternary row directions on four atoms. Rank-three linear equations have one-dimensional rational kernel; integer cofactor arithmetic yields their primitive positive integer vector. Hadamard bounds its components by five, proving the 63 sorted-case exhaustive limit. Two independent exact enumerations agree on eight sorted classes and 75 distinct ordered vectors; every class has three explicit independent witness equalities. Primitivity implies all positive integer population vectors are exactly positive integer multiples, giving the stated model spectra and sharp bound.
